en.headline: Shau Kei Wan streets intermittently closed for Wah Kwong Festival parade
en.dek: Transport Department advises drivers to avoid the area as roads close from 11am to 1pm today for the traditional celebration.
body: The Transport Department said intermittent lane closures would be in force in Shau Kei Wan on Saturday to facilitate the parade for the Celebration of Wah Kwong Festival 2026.

Roads affected between 11:00 and 13:00 include Nam On Lane, Nam On Street, Aldrich Street, Po Man Street, Mong Lung Street, Tung Hei Road, Tam Kung Temple Road, A Kung Ngam Village Road, Shau Kei Wan Main Street East, Kam Wa Street and Factory Street.

Police may adjust the arrangements or implement further measures depending on crowd conditions. The department advised motorists to avoid the area, use public transport where possible, and follow police instructions in case of congestion.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣華光先師寶誕巡遊 多條街道間歇封閉
zh.dek: 運輸署指今日上午11時至下午1時實施封路，方便傳統巡遊，駕駛者應避免前往受影響區域。
body: 運輸署表示，為配合「恭賀華光先師寶誕2026」巡遊，今日（星期六）在筱箕灣實施局部道路封閉。
上午11時至下午1時期間，南安里、南安街、愛秩序街、寶文街、望隆街、東喜道、譚公廟道、阿公岩村道、筱箕灣東大街、金華街及工廠街的行車線將間歇性封閉，禁止車輛駛入。
警方會視乎人潮及交通情況調整安排，或實施進一步措施。運輸署呼籲駕駛者避免前往受影響地區，盡量使用公共交通，並遵從警方指示。
